title: Frugal Rollout Checklist — Cost Ops Activation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket is the canonical rollout checklist and gating control for activating cost-reduction levers across hosted and dedicated deployments. Focus levers: request-level adaptive batching, KV/prefix caching (TTL & eviction policies), and model quantization profiles. Purpose is to provide an execution plan, telemetry gating, rollback criteria, and stakeholder runbook so each activation is repeatable and auditable.
acceptance_criteria: Achieve >=15% net token-cost reduction on pilot traffic without >5% increase in generated latency p95
No quality regressions >2% measured by PROMPT_SET_Aeval; manual review sign-off from ML lead
Canary rollout completes to 20% traffic with stability for 72 hours
Automated rollback triggers defined and tested in staging
Telemetries: cost-per-1M-tokens, p50/p95/p99 latency, request-error-rate, quality-delta mapped per model/version
